notes: All 46 unique arXiv IDs cited anywhere in the KB (domain_overview.md, metrics_and_baselines.md, field_conventions.md, deep-experiment-logs/*.md) were checked against arxiv.org/abs; every one resolved (HTTP 200 with a real paper title). No hallucinated/unresolvable arXiv ID found.
Only arxiv.org was contacted; downloads via https://arxiv.org/pdf/<id> with a browser User-Agent and ~3 s spacing.

KB characterization caveat (not an ID problem): arXiv:2512.11300 is titled "Distributed Quantum Magnetic Sensing for Infrastructure-free Geo-localization" (Le, Guo, Liu, NC State) and is a distributed-sensing / CRLB / geo-localization paper; PHASE0_DECISION.md and SCOOP_CHECK describe it as the amortized-BNN adaptive-tau paper. The ID is valid but the KB description appears to conflate it with the same group work mentioned in 2506.13469.
